title: ticfac status --json: one model of every run - lifecycle, waves, ticks, liveness, and what it waits on
description:
OPERATOR, 2026-09-23 (design worked through from first principles with the operator): the status VIEW is a renderer, not a source. This tick builds the model every surface renders - ticfac watch (89m), an agent checking in, a phone, the run feed idea n0r.

WHO READS IT, and the questions in priority order - an unattended factory is GLANCED at, not watched:
  1. does anything need a person? (untriaged findings, a decision, a merge, a halted run, a failed gate)
  2. is it healthy? (moving, retrying, stalled; interventions counted)
  3. how far along the WHOLE epic, and how much is left?
  4. what is happening now?
  5. what happened, what is next?

THE MODEL, per epic:
  - lifecycle: plan -> wave 1..n -> review -> close-out -> CI -> merge (a person); the current phase and each phase's state
  - waves: every wave (done, active, upcoming) with its ticks, from the same layering tk graph computes; absorbed ticks marked as such
  - per tick: state from DURABLE records only (never a worker's own claim), try number (h58's language) and prior tries' outcomes, tier/model/executor, elapsed
  - per live worker: seconds since the runner's last turn (pi's session log - the signal b1t moves to) and that turn's summary
  - waits_on: what the run is blocked on, since when, and the command that unblocks it when it needs a person
  - health: remote retries and interventions, gate and CI state per check per head
  - cost so far; remaining time ONLY where measured tick durations support it, marked approximate
Versioned and stable (a contract like run-event-feed.json), for local and cloud runs alike.

It reads only what exists - run feed and events, attempt records, checkpoints, pi session logs, GitHub check runs, ticfac cloud status - and adds no new source of truth.

acceptance_criteria: ticfac status --json emits a versioned model covering every local and cloud run: epic lifecycle phase, every wave with its ticks, per-tick state from durable records with try history, tier/model/executor and elapsed, per-worker silence and last turn, what the run waits on with an unblocking command when a person is needed, retries/interventions, CI per check per head, and cost; a contract fixture pins its shape; and it reads only existing records
